title: Provider Registry Entry
description: One externally maintained provider, stored as isvctl/configs/providers-registry/<name>.yaml. The provider's config/ and scripts/ live in the partner's own repository; this entry pins the exact commit that was validated. The loader additionally checks that `name` equals the filename stem and that every entry in `suites` exists under isvctl/configs/suites/.

schema_version.description: Registry entry schema version, bumped only on a breaking change to the entry format.

name.description: Registry name, used by `isvctl provider fetch <name>`. Must equal the filename stem.

vendor.description: Legal entity that maintains the provider.

description.description: One-sentence summary shown by `isvctl provider list`.

repo_url.description: HTTPS clone URL of the partner repository holding the provider's config/ and scripts/.

commit.description: Full 40-character commit SHA that was validated; `isvctl provider fetch` checks out exactly this commit.

tested_with.description: isvctl release (X.Y.Z or X.Y.Z-rcN, without a leading v) this commit was validated against.

maintainers.description: Partner contacts. GitHub handles are the ones added to CODEOWNERS for this entry.

documentation_url.description: HTTPS URL of instructions that let a user with appropriate access reproduce the validation results.

status.description: supported: maintained by its maintainers, and `commit` passed the declared suites against `tested_with` (support comes from the maintainers, not NVIDIA). deprecated: no longer maintained or validated; hidden from `isvctl provider list` unless --all. demo: scripts only return dummy results, like the living example; `isvctl test run --provider <name>` sets ISVCTL_DEMO_MODE=1 itself, and results are never uploaded.
